The climate in Tampere

Tampere is about 93 m above sea level. The warmest month is July, with an average high of 21°C; the coldest is January, when nights average −7°C. Around 730 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in July (about 91 mm). The highest temperature in Tampere in 2015–2024 was 31°C (25 June 2020) and the lowest −23°C (20 January 2016).

Best time to visit Tampere

The most pleasant weather in Tampere is usually in June, July and August: average highs are between 20°C and 21°C, with up to 14 days of rain a month. In January, February, March and December nights are frosty (below −3°C on average) and snow is common.
